links.outcome: Referral of ambiguous TB cases to clinicians versus autonomous clearance of healthy controls
links.effect: Referred 63.1% of ambiguous active TB cases to clinicians, flagged 32.5% as urgent for GeneXpert, and autonomously cleared 77.4% of healthy controls (178/230).
links.quote: In Indian hospital cohorts, the system referred 63.1% of ambiguous active TB cases to clinicians, flagging 32.5% as urgent for GeneXpert testing, while autonomously clearing 77.4% of healthy controls (178/230).

links.outcome: Missed TB cases (false-negative discharge) under conformal abstention and referral interlock
links.effect: False-negative discharge rate was 4.4% in India (9/203, down from 16.3% on baseline) and 0.0% in Pakistan (0/2,494), with 63.1% clinical referral.
links.quote: Among confirmed active TB cases, the false-negative discharge rate was 4.4% in India (9/203, down from 16.3% on baseline) and 0.0% in Pakistan (0/2,494), counterbalanced by 63.1% clinical referral.

unlisted_practices: Knowledge distillation of foundation model into small student network to improve robustness to shortcut learning
Mondrian split-conformal prediction for selective classification with abstention

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a student model distilled from BioMedCLIP equipped with a Mondrian split-conformal prediction interlock to manage clinical abstention/escalation (urgent molecular testing, autonomous clearance, or clinician referral) on external validation cohorts.

primary.practice: conformal prediction abstention and referral interlock
